"""Drives the interviewer through the proxy in-process, text only (no Gradium).
Mimics Gradbot: sends system + plain user/assistant text history, gets text back."""
import asyncio, json, os, sys, time
import dotenv, httpx
dotenv.load_dotenv(".env")
from src.api.app import app
from src.interview import llm_proxy, loader
from src.interview.flow import TOOLS, InterviewFlow
from src.interview.prompt import build_instructions

session = sys.argv[1]; answers = json.load(open(sys.argv[2]))
model = os.environ.get("TEST_MODEL") or os.environ["GEMINI_MODEL"]
inputs = loader.load_session(session); flow = InterviewFlow(inputs.questions); llm_proxy.register("t", flow)
tools = [{"type": "function", "function": {"name": t.name, "description": t.description, "parameters": json.loads(t.parameters_json)}} for t in TOOLS]
messages = [{"role": "system", "content": build_instructions(inputs)}, {"role": "user", "content": "[start]"}]
state = lambda: (flow.question_id, flow.in_followup, flow.ended)
key_for = lambda: "hello" if flow.question_id is None else (f"{flow.question_id}.followup" if flow.in_followup else flow.question_id)

async def turn(client):
    t0 = time.monotonic(); text = ""
    r = await client.post("/llm/s/t/chat/completions", json={"model": model, "messages": messages, "tools": tools, "stream": True, "max_completion_tokens": 4096})
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text[:300]
    for line in r.text.splitlines():
        if line.startswith("data:") and "[DONE]" not in line:
            delta = json.loads(line[5:])["choices"][0]["delta"]
            assert "tool_calls" not in delta, "a tool call leaked to Gradbot"
            text += delta.get("content") or ""
    messages.append({"role": "assistant", "content": text})
    print(f"AGENT ({time.monotonic()-t0:.1f}s) [{flow.question_id}{' followup' if flow.in_followup else ''}]: {text}")

async def main():
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(transport=httpx.ASGITransport(app=app), base_url="http://test", timeout=60) as client:
        await turn(client)
        key = key_for()
        for _ in range(12):
            print(f"CANDIDATE [{key}]: {answers[key][:70]}")
            messages.append({"role": "user", "content": answers[key]}); flow.candidate_spoke = True
            before = state(); await turn(client)
            if flow.ended: break
            key = "repeat" if state() == before else key_for()
        if flow.ended:
            messages.append({"role": "user", "content": answers["bye"]}); print("CANDIDATE [bye]:", answers["bye"]); await turn(client)
    print("ENDED:", flow.ended)
asyncio.run(main())
EOF

The complete dry run is done: a simulated candidate did a full voice interview against the real services in under 3 minutes, and it was evaluated into a report (73/100, hire). The browser side (your mic, playback, the page) is still the one part only you can test.

## Transcript
From `data/example/transcript.json` (F marks a follow-up):

| Time | Speaker | Q | Text |
| - | - | - | - |
| 3.8 | Agent | – | Hi Sam, I am Harper. How are you doing today? |
| 8.2 | Candidate | – | Hi Harper, I'm doing well, thanks. Happy to be here. |
| 15.2 | Agent | q1 | Glad to hear it. I have three questions about the codebase you would be working on. In our interview product, a language model scores each answer, but the final hiring score and the recommendation are calculated in plain code, not by the model. Why would you design it that way? |
| 33.4 | Candidate | q1 | has to be consistent and explainable. Models are bad at arithmetic and can give different results between runs. So I would let the model judge each answer and do the average and the thresholds in code. Then the same scores always give the same recommendation and you can audit it. |
| 53.7 | Agent | q1 F | Thanks. The evaluator also checks every quote the model cites against the transcript. What problem does that solve, and where does that check fall short? |
| 63.8 | Candidate | q1 F | It stops the model from inventing quotes, so the report only cites things the candidate really said, the limit is that it only checks the words exist, not that they actually support the score. |
| 77.9 | Agent | q2 | Got it. During the voice interview, the language model has to call a tool before it asks each question, and the server keeps track of where the interview is. What does that give us compared with simply writing the rules in the prompt? |
| 91.6 | Candidate | q2 | A prompt is just a suggestion, the model can ignore it, if the server keeps the state and the model has to ask through a tool, the server can refuse a question out of order or a second follow-up. |
| 104.3 | Agent | q2 F | Thanks. What happens if the model skips the tool call and just asks the next question out loud? |
| 112.8 | Candidate | q2 F | I guess the question just gets asked and nothing bad happens. |
| 120.1 | Agent | q3 | Got it. The interview transcript has to be saved when the interview ends normally, when the candidate closes the browser, and when a time limit is reached. How would you make sure it is saved in all three cases, and what could still go wrong? |
| 134.8 | Candidate | q3 | I would put the save in a finally block so it runs no matter how the session ends, and make the disconnect and the timer go through the same exit, what can still go wrong is a crash, because the transcript is only in memory, so I would also write each turn to disc as it happens. |
| 153.7 | Agent | – | Thank you for your time today, Sam, and have a great rest of your day! |
| 159.9 | Candidate | – | arper, by. |
| 163.1 | Agent | – | Bye! |

The report for this run is at `http://localhost:8000/static/report.html?session=example` once the server is running. It scored the three questions 88, 45 and 85; the 45 is the deliberately weak "I'm not sure" follow-up answer.

## What I changed to polish it
- **Hello on both sides:** the agent greets, asks how the candidate is, and waits for a reply before the first question.
- **Goodbye on both sides:** the session now stays open a few seconds after the agent's goodbye so the candidate's reply is heard and recorded.
- **Much shorter pauses:** the agent now starts replying about 2 seconds after the candidate stops (two replies took 3 to 4 seconds). Before, it was 5 to 9 seconds.
- **Questions asked word for word:** the question text now comes straight from your question documents, so the model cannot rephrase it. The model only adds the lead-in ("Thanks.", "Got it.").

The last two came from reworking the local proxy (now `src/interview/llm_proxy.py`): it holds the conversation with Gemini and runs the interviewer's tool calls itself, so Gradbot only receives text to speak.

## Things to know
- **Clipped first words:** three candidate turns lost their opening words in speech recognition ("Because the final number", "I'm not sure", "Thanks H"). I think that is my simulated candidate starting to talk a beat too early, but I haven't confirmed it. Watch for it when you speak yourself.
- **Gradium usage:** this session's dry runs used about 9 more minutes of streaming, on top of the roughly 10 from earlier testing. Three were full interviews, because the first two exposed problems.
- **Unit tests:** 39 pass.
- **Uncommitted:** all of this sits on top of your commit, along with the `CONTEXT.md` update.

To hear it yourself: `.venv/bin/uvicorn src.api.app:app`, then open `http://localhost:8000/?session=example`.

# Plan: interview feedback round (time limit, second chance, internal report, decision, fillers)

## Context

The interview and evaluation agents work end to end. This round applies six pieces of feedback:

1. Enforce a 10 to 15 minute limit and tell the candidate at the start.
2. Give a second chance when an answer is clearly wrong, sometimes with a small hint. Never a third.
3. The candidate must not see the report; it is internal.
4. The outcome is binary: move onward or reject. Onward: emphasise strengths and what future interviews should cover. Reject: give the reasoning.
5. Polish the report until it is spotless.
6. When Gemini is slow to answer, the interviewer says a short predefined filler ("Mhm.", "I see.", "Mmm, okay.").

Decisions made:
- **Second-chance scoring:** the improved answer counts, capped at 70 for that question, or 55 if a hint was given.
- **Advance bar:** overall score 60 and above, as a single constant (configurable later).
- **Report access:** separate links for candidate and recruiter, no key for now; the platform that creates interview links will wire access later.

## 1. Time limit

- `src/interview/session.py`: `WRAP_UP_AFTER_S = 12 min`, `MAX_INTERVIEW_S = 15 min` (env `INTERVIEW_WRAP_UP_S` / `INTERVIEW_MAX_S`, so tests can use seconds). The watchdog sets `flow.time_up = True` at wrap-up; the hard stop stays the existing time cap.
- `src/interview/flow.py`: when `time_up`, `start_question` / `ask_followup` / `second_chance` are refused ("time is up, close the interview") and `end_interview` is allowed even with questions left.
- `src/interview/llm_proxy.py`: on the first request after `time_up`, add a note to the Gemini conversation: tell the candidate time is up, thank them, call `end_interview`.
- `src/interview/prompt.py`: in the turn after the hello, say there are three questions and that it takes 15 minutes at most.
- `Transcript` gets `ended_reason`: `completed | time_limit | disconnected | stopped`. Questions not reached still score 0 (existing rule); the report states why the interview ended.

## 2. Second chance, optional hint, never a third

- New tool `second_chance(say, hint_given)` in `flow.py`. `say` is the one or two sentences the interviewer will speak (invite another try, optionally a small hint). The proxy speaks `say` directly, so it is one model call like questions.
- Flow rule: at most one second chance per thing asked (main question or follow-up); a second request is refused with "accept the answer and move on".
- Prompt: use it only when the answer is clearly wrong, off-target, or the candidate is stuck; not for partly right answers (that is what the follow-up is for). A hint points at the area to think about and never states any part of the reference answer.
- `Turn` gets `second_chance: bool` and `hint: bool`; the recorder tags turns after the tool call until the next step.
- Evaluator: prompt marks those turns; `finalize()` in `src/evaluation/evaluator.py` applies the caps in code (70, or 55 with a hint) and `QuestionReport` gets `second_chance_given` and `hint_given`.

## 3. Report is internal

- `web/index.html` (candidate page): remove the report link. Ending shows "Thank you. The team will be in touch."
- Evaluation runs automatically on the server when an interview ends (background task in `session.py` calling `evaluator.evaluate`), and the server logs the recruiter link.
- Report page moves out of the candidate's static folder: `internal/report.html`, served at `GET /internal/report?session=<id>`. `web/report.html` is deleted. API routes unchanged (`POST /sessions/{id}/evaluate`, `GET /sessions/{id}/report`), plus `GET /sessions/{id}/transcript` for the report page.

## 4. Binary decision with tailored write-up

- `Report.recommendation` becomes `decision: "advance" | "reject"`; `ADVANCE_MIN = 60` in `evaluator.py`.
- Evaluation becomes two Gemini calls: `judge()` (scores, unchanged role) then, once code has fixed the decision, `write_decision()` with the scores and the decision:
  - advance: `strengths` (emphasised, with evidence) and `next_interview_focus` (what later rounds should cover);
  - reject: `rejection_reasons` (specific, tied to answers), plus any real strengths briefly.
- Code blanks the lists that do not apply to the decision. Summary and reasoning are written in this second call so they match the decision.

## 5. Report polish

- Page layout: decision banner and score; why (strengths + next-round focus, or rejection reasons); interview facts (date, duration, how it ended, follow-ups and second chances used); one card per question (question, score, badges, assessment, covered / missed, quotes); profile alignment and red flags; full transcript in a collapsible section; advisory footer. Print stylesheet so it exports cleanly to PDF. All text still set via `textContent`.
- Content rules in the prompts: professional third person, full sentences, no filler, no contradictions between score and text, each list item one specific point, consistent capitalisation and punctuation (also normalised in code), quotes trimmed to the relevant sentence.
- Check with a screenshot of advance, reject and incomplete reports.

## 6. Fillers when Gemini is slow

- `llm_proxy.py`: if Gemini has produced nothing `FILLER_AFTER_S = 2.0` seconds after a candidate utterance (env `FILLER_AFTER_S`), send one filler to Gradbot first, then the real reply in the same stream. Fillers: "Mhm.", "I see.", "Mmm, okay.", "Right.", "Okay."; never the same twice in a row.
- Not used for the opening turn, silence prompts or after the interview has ended. The filler is recorded in the conversation so the model knows it was said.

## Files

| File | Change |
| - | - |
| `src/shared/models.py` | `Turn.second_chance`, `Turn.hint`, `Transcript.ended_reason`, `Report.decision`, write-up fields, `QuestionReport` flags |
| `src/interview/flow.py` | `time_up`, `second_chance` tool and rules |
| `src/interview/llm_proxy.py` | speak `second_chance` text, time-up note, fillers |
| `src/interview/prompt.py` | time announcement, second-chance and hint rules |
| `src/interview/recorder.py`, `session.py` | new tags, `ended_reason`, wrap-up timer, auto-evaluate |
| `src/evaluation/prompt.py`, `evaluator.py` | caps, decision, `write_decision()` |
| `src/api/app.py` | internal report route, transcript route |
| `web/index.html`, `internal/report.html` | candidate ending, new report page |
| `tests/` | flow (time up, one second chance), proxy (filler, second chance), evaluator (caps, decision, blanked lists) |
| `fixtures/demo/transcript.json`, `CONTEXT.md` | new fields, contracts, behaviour |

## Verification

- `pytest tests`.
- Text-only run through the proxy (Gemini only): normal run; a wrong answer triggers exactly one second chance; a second wrong answer moves on; with `INTERVIEW_WRAP_UP_S` set low the agent closes early; with `FILLER_AFTER_S=0.1` a filler precedes replies.
- Evaluate fixtures for advance, reject, second-chance caps and time-limit endings; screenshot each report.
- One capped voice dry run on `example` (about 3 minutes of Gradium) to confirm fillers and second chances sound right, then show the transcript and report.

# Plan: evaluation agent + report page

## Context

The interview agent now writes `data/<session>/transcript.json`. The evaluation agent is the last step: it reads the transcript, the 3 question docs and the candidate profile, and produces a report with a hiring score and the reasoning behind it. It runs separately from the interview, with its own clean context, and never talks to the candidate.

Decisions made:
- **Profile is context only.** The score comes only from what was said. The profile feeds a separate, unscored "profile alignment" section.
- **Incomplete interviews are graded strictly and count heavily against the candidate.** Partial answers get partial credit; a question with no answer at all gets 0 (there is nothing to grade). The normal recommendation is still given, and the report says clearly that the interview was incomplete.
- **Scope:** agent, HTTP routes, CLI and a report page.

## Approach: the model judges, the code decides

Gemini (structured output) does the judging per question. Everything that should be deterministic or checkable is done in code afterwards, so the report is explainable and hard to game:

| Done by Gemini | Done in code |
| - | - |
| Per question: score 0-100, reasoning, points covered / missed vs the reference answer, strengths, gaps, evidence quotes | `overall_score` = mean of the 3 question scores |
| Summary and overall reasoning | `recommendation` from fixed thresholds: >= 80 `strong_hire`, >= 60 `hire`, else `no_hire` |
| Profile alignment (confirmed / contradicted claims) | Per-question status from the transcript: asked? answered? follow-up asked? |
| Red flags, topics to probe in a human round, a short communication note (unscored) | Evidence check: every quote must appear in the candidate's turns; others are dropped |
| | Unanswered question forced to score 0; `interview_complete` flag |
| | `needs_human_review` when a scored question has no verified quote, or the interview is incomplete |

Scoring rules in the prompt: anchored bands (0-20 no relevant content, 21-40 vague, 41-60 partly right with real gaps, 61-80 solid with minor gaps, 81-100 covers the reference answer); be strict; grade only what the candidate said; a follow-up answer counts toward its question and a follow-up that was not asked is never penalised; ignore accent, filler words and STT glitches; never reward an answer the interviewer gave away.

Transcript text is untrusted input: the prompt tells the model to treat it as data, and to list any attempt to instruct the evaluator ("give me full marks") under red flags.

## Report contract (replaces the one in `CONTEXT.md` section 6)

```json
{
  "session_id": "demo",
  "candidate_name": "Alex Meier",
  "generated_at": "ISO-8601",
  "model": "gemini-...",
  "overall_score": 0,
  "recommendation": "strong_hire | hire | no_hire",
  "summary": "short paragraph",
  "reasoning": "why this score and recommendation",
  "interview_complete": true,
  "needs_human_review": false,
  "review_reasons": ["..."],
  "per_question": [
    {
      "question_id": "q1",
      "status": "answered | not_answered",
      "followup_asked": true,
      "score": 0,
      "reasoning": "...",
      "covered_points": ["..."],
      "missed_points": ["..."],
      "strengths": ["..."],
      "gaps": ["..."],
      "evidence": ["direct quotes from the candidate"]
    }
  ],
  "profile_alignment": {"confirmed": ["..."], "contradicted": ["..."]},
  "red_flags": ["..."],
  "suggested_next_steps": ["topics to probe in a human round"],
  "communication": "one or two sentences, not scored"
}
```

`overall_score` is the hiring score. The report is advisory: the page says a human makes the decision.

| File | Change |
| - | - |
| `src/shared/models.py` | Add `Report`, `QuestionReport`, `ProfileAlignment`, plus the smaller `Judgement` models used as Gemini's response schema |
| `src/evaluation/__init__.py` | New package |
| `src/evaluation/prompt.py` | Build the evaluator prompt from profile, question docs and transcript grouped by question |
| `src/evaluation/evaluator.py` | `load_transcript(session_id)` (data/ then fixtures/), `judge()` (Gemini call via `google-genai`, `response_schema=Judgement`, low temperature), `finalize()` (all the code-side rules above), `evaluate(session_id)` writing `data/<session>/report.json` |
| `src/evaluation/__main__.py` | CLI: `python -m src.evaluation <session>` |
| `src/api/app.py` | `POST /sessions/{id}/evaluate`, `GET /sessions/{id}/report` (404 until it exists) |
| `web/report.html` | Report page: score and recommendation up top, incomplete / needs-review banners, summary and reasoning, one card per question with score, covered / missed points and quotes, then profile alignment, red flags and next steps |

"""One voice interview over a browser WebSocket.

Same wire protocol as gradbot.websocket.handle_session (start message, binary
audio frames, stop message), but with our own loop so every spoken turn is
recorded server-side and written to data/<session>/transcript.json.
"""

import asyncio
import contextlib
import json
import logging
import os
import secrets
import time

import fastapi
import gradbot

from src.interview import llm_proxy, loader
from src.interview.flow import TOOLS, InterviewFlow
from src.interview.prompt import build_instructions
from src.interview.recorder import TranscriptRecorder

logger = logging.getLogger("interview")

VOICE = "Harper"
MAX_INTERVIEW_S = 10 * 60
# After end_interview: stop once the goodbye audio has been quiet this long.
# After the goodbye has played, the candidate gets this long to start saying bye back.
GOODBYE_REPLY_WINDOW_S = 4.0
# Once they have replied, wait this long after their last word (and for any
# short answer from the agent to play out) before closing.
GOODBYE_REPLY_SETTLE_S = 5.0
GOODBYE_MAX_S = 25.0
# Margin for audio still buffered in the browser when the socket closes.
PLAYOUT_GRACE_S = 1.5


class ConfigError(Exception):
    pass


def _run_kwargs(port: int, token: str) -> dict:
    """Gradbot client settings, using the env names from CONTEXT.md section 9.

    The LLM URL is this session's endpoint on our own proxy
    (src/interview/llm_proxy.py), which talks to Gemini and runs the tools.
    """
    required = {
        "gradium_api_key": "GRADIUM_API_KEY",
        "llm_api_key": "GEMINI_API_KEY",
        "llm_model_name": "GEMINI_MODEL",
    }
    kwargs = {key: os.environ.get(env, "").strip() for key, env in required.items()}
    missing = [required[key] for key, value in kwargs.items() if not value]
    if missing:
        raise ConfigError(f"missing environment variables: {', '.join(missing)}")
    kwargs["llm_base_url"] = f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/llm/s/{token}"
    return kwargs


def _session_config(inputs: loader.InterviewInputs) -> gradbot.SessionConfig:
    voice = gradbot.flagship_voice(VOICE)
    return gradbot.SessionConfig(
        voice_id=voice.voice_id,
        language=voice.language,
        instructions=build_instructions(inputs),
        tools=TOOLS,
        assistant_speaks_first=True,
        # Optional JSON passed to the LLM request, e.g. {"reasoning_effort": "none"}
        llm_extra_config=os.environ.get("LLM_EXTRA_CONFIG") or None,
    )


async def run_interview(websocket: fastapi.WebSocket, session_id: str) -> None:
    await websocket.accept()
    token = secrets.token_urlsafe(8)
    try:
        inputs = loader.load_session(session_id)
        run_kwargs = _run_kwargs(websocket.url.port or 80, token)
    except (loader.SessionError, ConfigError) as exc:
        logger.error("cannot start interview %s: %s", session_id, exc)
        await websocket.send_json({"type": "error", "message": str(exc)})
        await websocket.close(code=4001)
        return

    try:
        start_msg = await websocket.receive_json()
    except fastapi.WebSocketDisconnect:
        return
    if start_msg.get("type") != "start":
        await websocket.close(code=4000, reason="Expected start message")
        return

    flow = InterviewFlow(inputs.questions)
    llm_proxy.register(token, flow)  # the proxy runs the interviewer's tool calls on this flow
    recorder = TranscriptRecorder(session_id, inputs.candidate_name)
    stop = asyncio.Event()

"""Interview flow state, driven by the interviewer's tool calls.

The LLM asks for each step through a tool. The state lives here, so the order
of questions, the one-follow-up limit, the one-second-chance limit and the
time limit are enforced by code, not by the prompt. Every method returns the
JSON-able tool result sent back to the LLM.
"""

import json

import gradbot

from src.shared.models import Question

_NO_ARGS = json.dumps({"type": "object", "properties": {}})

TOOLS = [
    gradbot.ToolDef(
        "start_question",
        "Ask the next main interview question. The question is spoken for you, word for word.",
        json.dumps(
            {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                    "question_id": {
                        "type": "string",
                        "description": "Id of the question to ask, e.g. q1",
                    }
                },
                "required": ["question_id"],
            }
        ),
    ),
    gradbot.ToolDef(
        "ask_followup",
        "Ask the prepared follow-up of the current question. It is spoken for you, word for word.",
        _NO_ARGS,
    ),
    gradbot.ToolDef(
        "second_chance",
        "Give the candidate one more try at what was just asked, because their answer was "
        "clearly wrong, off target, or they were stuck. Allowed once per question or follow-up.",
        json.dumps(
            {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                    "say": {
                        "type": "string",
                        "description": "The one or two sentences to speak: invite another try, "
                        "optionally with a small hint. Never part of the reference answer.",
                    },
                    "hint_given": {
                        "type": "boolean",
                        "description": "True if `say` contains a hint.",
                    },
                },
                "required": ["say", "hint_given"],
            }
        ),
    ),
    gradbot.ToolDef(
        "end_interview",
        "Close the interview: after the last question has been answered, or when told the "
        "time is up.",
        _NO_ARGS,
    ),
]

_TIME_UP = "The time limit has been reached. Do not ask anything else: call end_interview."


class InterviewFlow:
    def __init__(self, questions: list[Question]):
        self.questions = questions
        self._index = -1
        # Set by the session once the candidate has said anything: the first
        # question may not start before the hello has been exchanged.
        self.candidate_spoke = False
        # Set by the session when the wrap-up time is reached.
        self.time_up = False
        self.in_followup = False
        self._followup_used = False
        # Second chance state for the thing currently asked (question or follow-up).
        self.in_second_chance = False
        self.hint = False
        self._second_chance_used = False
        self.ended = False

    @property
    def current(self) -> Question | None:
        return self.questions[self._index] if self._index >= 0 else None

    @property
    def question_id(self) -> str | None:
        """Tag for transcript turns: None before the first question and after the end."""
        if self.ended or self.current is None:
            return None
        return self.current.id

    @property
    def remaining(self) -> list[str]:
        return [q.id for q in self.questions[self._index + 1 :]]

    @property
    def ended_reason(self) -> str:
        return "time_limit" if self.time_up and self.remaining else "completed"

    def _new_item(self) -> None:
        self.in_second_chance = False
        self.hint = False
        self._second_chance_used = False

    def start_question(self, question_id: str) -> dict:
        if self.ended:
            return {"error": "The interview has already ended."}
        if self.time_up:
            return {"error": _TIME_UP}
        if not self.remaining:
            return {"error": "All questions have been asked. Call end_interview."}
        if not self.candidate_spoke:
            return {
                "error": "Say hello and introduce yourself first, then wait for the "
                "candidate to reply. Do not ask a question yet."
            }
        expected = self.questions[self._index + 1]
        if question_id != expected.id:
            return {"error": f"Questions go in order. The next one is {expected.id}."}
        self._index += 1
        self.in_followup = False
        self._followup_used = False
        self._new_item()
        return {"ok": True, "say": expected.question}

    def ask_followup(self) -> dict:
        question = self.current
        if self.ended or question is None:
            return {"error": "No question is in progress."}
        if self.time_up:
            return {"error": _TIME_UP}
        if question.followup is None:
            return {"error": f"{question.id} has no follow-up. Move on."}
        if self._followup_used:
            return {"error": f"The follow-up for {question.id} was already asked. Move on."}
        self._followup_used = True
        self.in_followup = True
        self._new_item()
        return {"ok": True, "say": question.followup.question}

    def second_chance(self, say: str, hint_given: bool) -> dict:
        if self.ended or self.current is None:
            return {"error": "No question is in progress."}
        if self.time_up:
            return {"error": _TIME_UP}
        if self._second_chance_used:
            return {
                "error": "A second chance was already given here and there is never a third. "
                "Accept the answer and move on."
            }
        say = " ".join(str(say or "").split())
        if not say:
            return {"error": "`say` is empty. Provide the words to speak."}
        self._second_chance_used = True
        self.in_second_chance = True
        self.hint = bool(hint_given)
        return {"ok": True, "say": say}

    def end_interview(self) -> dict:
        if self.ended:
            return {"ok": True}
        if self.remaining and not self.time_up:
            return {"error": f"Not finished. Still to ask: {', '.join(self.remaining)}."}
        instruction = "Thank the candidate and say goodbye in one sentence."
        if self.time_up and self.remaining:
            instruction = (
                "Tell the candidate kindly that the time is up, thank them and say goodbye, "
                "in two sentences at most."
            )
        self.ended = True
        self.in_followup = False
        self.in_second_chance = False
        self.hint = False
        return {"ok": True, "say": instruction}

    def handle(self, name: str, args: dict) -> dict:
        if name == "start_question":
            return self.start_question(str(args.get("question_id", "")))
        if name == "ask_followup":
            return self.ask_followup()
        if name == "second_chance":
            return self.second_chance(args.get("say", ""), bool(args.get("hint_given")))
        if name == "end_interview":
            return self.end_interview()
        return {"error": f"Unknown tool: {name}"}

"""Pydantic models for the contracts in CONTEXT.md section 6."""

from typing import Literal

import pydantic

class Followup(pydantic.BaseModel):
    question: str
    answer: str
    context: str


class Question(pydantic.BaseModel):
    id: str
    question: str
    answer: str
    context: str
    followup: Followup | None = None


class Turn(pydantic.BaseModel):
    speaker: Literal["agent", "candidate"]

    question_id: str | None = None
    followup: bool = False
    # True from the interviewer's "try again" until the next question or follow-up.
    second_chance: bool = False
    # True when that second chance came with a hint.
    hint: bool = False
    text: str
    t: float

    session_id: str
    candidate_name: str

"""Interview flow state, driven by the interviewer's tool calls.

The LLM asks for each step through a tool. The state lives here, so the order
of questions, the one-follow-up limit, the one-second-chance limit and the
time limit are enforced by code, not by the prompt. Every method returns the
JSON-able tool result sent back to the LLM.
"""

import json

import gradbot

from src.shared.models import Question

_NO_ARGS = json.dumps({"type": "object", "properties": {}})

TOOLS = [
    gradbot.ToolDef(
        "start_question",
        "Ask the next main interview question. The question is spoken for you, word for word.",
        json.dumps(
            {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                    "question_id": {
                        "type": "string",
                        "description": "Id of the question to ask, e.g. q1",
                    }
                },
                "required": ["question_id"],
            }
        ),
    ),
    gradbot.ToolDef(
        "ask_followup",
        "Ask the prepared follow-up of the current question. It is spoken for you, word for word.",
        _NO_ARGS,
    ),
    gradbot.ToolDef(
        "second_chance",
        "Give the candidate one more try at what was just asked, because their answer was "
        "clearly wrong, off target, or they were stuck. Allowed once per question or follow-up.",
        json.dumps(
            {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                    "say": {
                        "type": "string",
                        "description": "The one or two sentences to speak: invite another try, "
                        "optionally with a small hint. Never part of the reference answer.",
                    },
                    "hint_given": {
                        "type": "boolean",
                        "description": "True if `say` contains a hint.",
                    },
                },
                "required": ["say", "hint_given"],
            }
        ),
    ),
    gradbot.ToolDef(
        "end_interview",
        "Close the interview: after the last question has been answered, or when told the "
        "time is up.",
        _NO_ARGS,
    ),
]

_TIME_UP = "The time limit has been reached. Do not ask anything else: call end_interview."


class InterviewFlow:
    def __init__(self, questions: list[Question]):
        self.questions = questions
        self._index = -1
        # Set by the session once the candidate has said anything: the first
        # question may not start before the hello has been exchanged.
        self.candidate_spoke = False
        # Set by the session when the wrap-up time is reached.
        self.time_up = False
        self.in_followup = False
        self._followup_used = False
        # Second chance state for the thing currently asked (question or follow-up).
        self.in_second_chance = False
        self.hint = False
        self._second_chance_used = False
        self.ended = False

    @property
    def current(self) -> Question | None:
        return self.questions[self._index] if self._index >= 0 else None

    @property
    def question_id(self) -> str | None:
        """Tag for transcript turns: None before the first question and after the end."""
        if self.ended or self.current is None:
            return None
        return self.current.id

    @property
    def remaining(self) -> list[str]:
        return [q.id for q in self.questions[self._index + 1 :]]

    @property
    def ended_reason(self) -> str:
        return "time_limit" if self.time_up and self.remaining else "completed"

    def _new_item(self) -> None:
        self.in_second_chance = False
        self.hint = False
        self._second_chance_used = False

    def start_question(self, question_id: str) -> dict:
        if self.ended:
            return {"error": "The interview has already ended."}
        if self.time_up:
            return {"error": _TIME_UP}
        if not self.remaining:
            return {"error": "All questions have been asked. Call end_interview."}
        if not self.candidate_spoke:
            return {
                "error": "Say hello and introduce yourself first, then wait for the "
                "candidate to reply. Do not ask a question yet."
            }
        expected = self.questions[self._index + 1]
        if question_id != expected.id:
            return {"error": f"Questions go in order. The next one is {expected.id}."}
        self._index += 1
        self.in_followup = False
        self._followup_used = False
        self._new_item()
        return {"ok": True, "say": expected.question}

    def ask_followup(self) -> dict:
        question = self.current
        if self.ended or question is None:
            return {"error": "No question is in progress."}
        if self.time_up:
            return {"error": _TIME_UP}
        if question.followup is None:
            return {"error": f"{question.id} has no follow-up. Move on."}
        if self._followup_used:
            return {"error": f"The follow-up for {question.id} was already asked. Move on."}
        self._followup_used = True
        self.in_followup = True
        self._new_item()
        return {"ok": True, "say": question.followup.question}

    def second_chance(self, say: str, hint_given: bool) -> dict:
        if self.ended or self.current is None:
            return {"error": "No question is in progress."}
        if self.time_up:
            return {"error": _TIME_UP}
        if self._second_chance_used:
            return {
                "error": "A second chance was already given here and there is never a third. "
                "Accept the answer and move on."
            }
        say = " ".join(str(say or "").split())
        if not say:
            return {"error": "`say` is empty. Provide the words to speak."}
        self._second_chance_used = True
        self.in_second_chance = True
        self.hint = bool(hint_given)
        return {"ok": True, "say": say}

    def end_interview(self) -> dict:
        if self.ended:
            return {"ok": True}
        if self.remaining and not self.time_up:
            return {"error": f"Not finished. Still to ask: {', '.join(self.remaining)}."}
        instruction = "Thank the candidate and say goodbye in one sentence."
        if self.time_up and self.remaining:
            instruction = (
                "Tell the candidate kindly that the time is up, thank them and say goodbye, "
                "in two sentences at most."
            )
        self.ended = True
        self.in_followup = False
        self.in_second_chance = False
        self.hint = False
        return {"ok": True, "say": instruction}

    def handle(self, name: str, args: dict) -> dict:
        if name == "start_question":
            return self.start_question(str(args.get("question_id", "")))
        if name == "ask_followup":
            return self.ask_followup()
        if name == "second_chance":
            return self.second_chance(args.get("say", ""), bool(args.get("hint_given")))
        if name == "end_interview":
            return self.end_interview()
        return {"error": f"Unknown tool: {name}"}

"""Builds the Transcript from the text fragments Gradbot emits during a session."""

import datetime
import pathlib
import time

from src.shared.models import Transcript, Turn


def _now() -> str:
    return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds")


class TranscriptRecorder:
    def __init__(self, session_id: str, candidate_name: str):
        self.session_id = session_id
        self.candidate_name = candidate_name
        self.started_at = _now()
        self._t0 = time.monotonic()
        self.turns: list[Turn] = []

    def add(
        self,
        speaker: str,
        text: str,
        question_id: str | None,
        followup: bool = False,
        second_chance: bool = False,
        hint: bool = False,
        t: float | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        """Append a fragment, merging it into the last turn when nothing changed."""
        text = " ".join(text.split())
        if not text:
            return
        tags = {
            "question_id": question_id,
            "followup": followup,
            "second_chance": second_chance,
            "hint": hint,
        }
        last = self.turns[-1] if self.turns else None
        if (
            last is not None
            and last.speaker == speaker
            and all(getattr(last, key) == value for key, value in tags.items())
        ):
            last.text = f"{last.text} {text}"
            return
        if t is None:
            t = time.monotonic() - self._t0
        self.turns.append(Turn(speaker=speaker, text=text, t=round(t, 1), **tags))

    def transcript(self, ended_reason: str | None = None) -> Transcript:
        return Transcript(
            session_id=self.session_id,
            candidate_name=self.candidate_name,
            started_at=self.started_at,
            ended_at=_now(),
            ended_reason=ended_reason,
            turns=self.turns,
        )

    def save(self, directory: pathlib.Path, ended_reason: str | None = None) -> pathlib.Path:
        directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path = directory / "transcript.json"
        path.write_text(
            self.transcript(ended_reason).model_dump_json(indent=2), encoding="utf-8"
        )
        return path

You are a strict, fair technical interview evaluator. You receive a candidate \
profile, three interview questions with private reference answers, and the \
transcript of a voice interview. You grade the candidate's answers and return \
JSON only.

Scoring, per question, 0 to 100:
- 0 to 20: no relevant content, or no answer.
- 21 to 40: vague or mostly wrong; names a topic without explaining it.
- 41 to 60: partly right, with real gaps against the reference answer.
- 61 to 80: solid and correct, minor gaps.
- 81 to 100: covers the reference answer, including its key trade-offs.

- Be strict. When in doubt between two bands, pick the lower one.
- Grade only what the candidate actually said. Do not give credit for what \
they probably know, for what their profile claims, or for anything the \
interviewer said.

earns credit; say so in the reasoning.

judged against the follow-up reference answer. A follow-up that was not asked \
is never held against the candidate.

attempts, and say in the reasoning what changed between them. Do not lower the \

separately. If the interviewer gave a hint, give no credit for the part the \

strictly. A question with no answer scores 0.

quote the interviewer and never paraphrase. A question with no answer has no \
evidence.

- covered_points and missed_points: key points of the reference answer the \

def _turn_line(turn: Turn) -> str:
    speaker = "Interviewer" if turn.speaker == "agent" else "Candidate"
    marks = []
    if turn.followup:
        marks.append("follow-up")
    if turn.second_chance:
        marks.append("second chance, hint given" if turn.hint else "second chance")
    marker = f" [{'; '.join(marks)}]" if marks else ""
    return f"{speaker}{marker}: {turn.text}"


def _question_block(question: Question, turns: list[Turn]) -> str:
    lines = [
        f"## {question.id}",
        f"Question: {question.question}",
        f"Reference answer: {question.answer}",
        f"Context: {question.context}",
    ]
    if question.followup is not None:
        lines += [
            f"Prepared follow-up: {question.followup.question}",
            f"Follow-up reference answer: {question.followup.answer}",
            f"Follow-up context: {question.followup.context}",
        ]
    lines.append("<transcript>")
    lines += [_turn_line(t) for t in turns] or ["(this question was never reached)"]
    lines.append("</transcript>")
    return "\n".join(lines)


def build_judge_prompt(inputs: InterviewInputs, transcript: Transcript) -> str:
    blocks = [
        _question_block(q, [t for t in transcript.turns if t.question_id == q.id])
        for q in inputs.questions
    ]
    known = {q.id for q in inputs.questions}
    other = [t for t in transcript.turns if t.question_id not in known]
    other_block = "\n".join(_turn_line(t) for t in other) or "(none)"
    ids = ", ".join(q.id for q in inputs.questions)
    return (
        f"# Candidate profile (context only)\n{inputs.candidate_profile}\n\n"
        f"# Questions and what was said\n" + "\n\n".join(blocks) + "\n\n"
        f"# Outside the questions (introduction, closing)\n"
        f"<transcript>\n{other_block}\n</transcript>\n\n"
        f"Return one per_question entry for each of: {ids}."
    )


ENDINGS = {
    "completed": "The interview ran to the end.",
    "time_limit": "The interview was cut short by the time limit.",
    "disconnected": "The candidate's connection dropped before the interview finished.",
    "stopped": "The interview was stopped before it finished.",
}


def build_writeup_prompt(
    decision: str,
    overall_score: int,
    advance_min: int,
    per_question: list[QuestionReport],
    ended_reason: str | None,
    red_flags: list[str],
) -> str:
    questions = []
    for q in per_question:
        notes = []
        if q.status == "not_answered":
            notes.append("not answered")
        if q.followup_asked:
            notes.append("follow-up asked")
        if q.second_chance_given:
            notes.append("second chance given" + (" with a hint" if q.hint_given else ""))
        if q.score_before_cap is not None:
            notes.append(
                f"score capped from {q.score_before_cap} to {q.score} because a second "
                "chance was needed"
            )
        questions.append(
            {
                "question_id": q.question_id,
                "question": q.question,
                "score": q.score,
                "notes": notes,
                "grader_reasoning": q.reasoning,
                "covered_points": q.covered_points,
                "missed_points": q.missed_points,
                "strengths": q.strengths,
                "gaps": q.gaps,
            }
        )
    payload = {
        "decision": decision,
        "overall_score": overall_score,
        "rule": f"advance at {advance_min} or above, otherwise reject",
        "how_the_interview_ended": ENDINGS.get(ended_reason or "", "Unknown."),
        "red_flags": red_flags,
        "questions": questions,
    }
    return json.dumps(payload, indent=2)

"""Evaluation agent: transcript + question docs + profile -> Report.

The model judges, the code decides:

1. judge()          Gemini grades each answer (Judgement).
2. assess()         Code checks the judgement against the transcript, applies
                    the scoring rules and fixes the decision (Assessment).
3. write_decision() Gemini explains the decision that code made (Writeup).
4. finalize()       Code assembles the Report.
"""

import dataclasses
import datetime
import os
import pathlib
import re
import statistics

from src.evaluation import prompt
from src.interview import loader
from src.interview.loader import InterviewInputs
from src.shared.models import (
    Judgement,
    QuestionJudgement,
    QuestionReport,
    Report,
    Transcript,
    Writeup,
)

# Overall score needed to move on to the next round. One constant for now.
ADVANCE_MIN = 60
# A question that needed a second chance cannot score above these.
SECOND_CHANCE_CAP = 70
HINT_CAP = 55


class EvaluationError(Exception):
    pass


@dataclasses.dataclass
class Assessment:
    per_question: list[QuestionReport]
    overall_score: int
    decision: str
    interview_complete: bool
    review_reasons: list[str]


def load_transcript(session_id: str) -> Transcript:
    loader.session_dir(session_id)  # validates the id
    for base in (loader.DATA_DIR, loader.FIXTURES_DIR):
        path = base / session_id / "transcript.json"
        if path.is_file():
            return Transcript.model_validate_json(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    raise EvaluationError(f"no transcript found for session {session_id!r}")


def _generate(model: str, system: str, contents: str, schema):
    """One Gemini call with structured output."""
    from google import genai
    from google.genai import types

    api_key = os.environ.get("GEMINI_API_KEY", "").strip()
    if not api_key:
        raise EvaluationError("missing environment variable: GEMINI_API_KEY")
    client = genai.Client(api_key=api_key)
    response = client.models.generate_content(
        model=model,
        contents=contents,
        config=types.GenerateContentConfig(
            system_instruction=system,
            response_mime_type="application/json",
            response_schema=schema,
            temperature=0.1,
        ),
    )
    if isinstance(response.parsed, schema):
        return response.parsed
    try:
        return schema.model_validate_json(response.text or "")
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise EvaluationError(f"evaluator returned invalid JSON: {exc}") from exc


def judge(inputs: InterviewInputs, transcript: Transcript, model: str) -> Judgement:
    """Ask Gemini to grade each answer."""
    contents = prompt.build_judge_prompt(inputs, transcript)
    return _generate(model, prompt.JUDGE_SYSTEM, contents, Judgement)


def write_decision(
    assessment: Assessment, transcript: Transcript, judgement: Judgement, model: str
) -> Writeup:
    """Ask Gemini to explain the decision that assess() made."""
    contents = prompt.build_writeup_prompt(
        assessment.decision,
        assessment.overall_score,
        ADVANCE_MIN,
        assessment.per_question,
        transcript.ended_reason,
        judgement.red_flags,
    )
    return _generate(model, prompt.WRITEUP_SYSTEM, contents, Writeup)


def _normalise(text: str) -> str:
    return " ".join(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", " ", text.lower()).split())


def _sentence(text: str) -> str:
    """Tidy model prose: one line, capitalised, ending with punctuation."""
    text = " ".join(str(text).split()).lstrip("-•* ").strip()
    if not text:
        return ""
    text = text[0].upper() + text[1:]
    return text if text[-1] in ".!?" else text + "."


def _points(items: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    """Tidy a list of points and drop empty or repeated ones."""
    seen, result = set(), []
    for item in items:
        point = _sentence(item)
        key = _normalise(point)
        if key and key not in seen:
            seen.add(key)
            result.append(point)
    return result


def decide(overall_score: int) -> str:
    return "advance" if overall_score >= ADVANCE_MIN else "reject"


def _empty(question_id: str, reasoning: str, gaps: list[str]) -> QuestionJudgement:
    return QuestionJudgement(
        question_id=question_id,
        score=0,
        reasoning=reasoning,
        covered_points=[],
        missed_points=[],
        strengths=[],
        gaps=gaps,
        evidence=[],
    )


def assess(inputs: InterviewInputs, transcript: Transcript, judgement: Judgement) -> Assessment:
    judged = {j.question_id: j for j in judgement.per_question}
    # Quotes are checked against everything the candidate said, not only the
    # turns tagged with that question: tagging can be off by a turn.
    spoken = _normalise(" ".join(t.text for t in transcript.turns if t.speaker == "candidate"))
    review_reasons: list[str] = []
    per_question: list[QuestionReport] = []

    for question in inputs.questions:
        turns = [t for t in transcript.turns if t.question_id == question.id]
        asked = any(t.speaker == "agent" for t in turns)
        answered = any(t.speaker == "candidate" and _normalise(t.text) for t in turns)
        facts = {
            "question": question.question,
            "followup_asked": any(t.followup for t in turns),
            "second_chance_given": any(t.second_chance for t in turns),
            "hint_given": any(t.hint for t in turns),
        }
        result = judged.get(question.id)

        if not answered:
            why = "was asked but got no answer" if asked else "was never reached"
            empty = _empty(
                question.id,
                f"This question {why}, so there is nothing to grade. It scores 0.",
                ["No answer was given."],
            )
            per_question.append(
                QuestionReport(**empty.model_dump(), status="not_answered", **facts)
            )
            review_reasons.append(f"{question.id} {why}.")
            continue

        if result is None:
            result = _empty(
                question.id, "The evaluator returned no judgement for this question.", []
            )
            review_reasons.append(f"{question.id} has no judgement from the evaluator.")

        evidence = [
            " ".join(q.split()) for q in result.evidence if _normalise(q) and _normalise(q) in spoken
        ]
        dropped = len(result.evidence) - len(evidence)
        if dropped:
            review_reasons.append(
                f"{question.id}: {dropped} quote(s) not found in the transcript were removed."
            )

        score = max(0, min(100, result.score))
        score_before_cap = None
        if facts["second_chance_given"]:
            cap = HINT_CAP if facts["hint_given"] else SECOND_CHANCE_CAP
            if score > cap:
                score_before_cap, score = score, cap
        if score > 0 and not evidence:
            review_reasons.append(f"{question.id} is scored without a verified quote.")

        per_question.append(
            QuestionReport(
                question_id=question.id,
                score=score,
                score_before_cap=score_before_cap,
                reasoning=_sentence(result.reasoning),
                covered_points=_points(result.covered_points),
                missed_points=_points(result.missed_points),
                strengths=_points(result.strengths),
                gaps=_points(result.gaps),
                evidence=evidence,
                status="answered",
                **facts,
            )
        )

    if judgement.red_flags:
        review_reasons.append(f"{len(judgement.red_flags)} red flag(s) raised.")
    if transcript.ended_reason not in (None, "completed"):
        review_reasons.append(prompt.ENDINGS[transcript.ended_reason])

    overall = round(statistics.mean(q.score for q in per_question))
    return Assessment(
        per_question=per_question,
        overall_score=overall,
        decision=decide(overall),
        interview_complete=all(q.status == "answered" for q in per_question),
        review_reasons=review_reasons,
    )


def _duration(transcript: Transcript) -> int | None:
    try:
        started = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(transcript.started_at)
        ended = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(transcript.ended_at)
    except ValueError:
        return None
    return max(0, round((ended - started).total_seconds()))


def finalize(
    assessment: Assessment,
    transcript: Transcript,
    judgement: Judgement,
    writeup: Writeup,
    model: str,
) -> Report:
    advance = assessment.decision == "advance"
    return Report(
        session_id=transcript.session_id,
        candidate_name=transcript.candidate_name,
        generated_at=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
        model=model,
        overall_score=assessment.overall_score,
        decision=assessment.decision,
        summary=" ".join(writeup.summary.split()),
        reasoning=" ".join(writeup.reasoning.split()),
        strengths=_points(writeup.strengths),
        # Each decision shows only its own section, whatever the model returned.
        next_interview_focus=_points(writeup.next_interview_focus) if advance else [],
        rejection_reasons=[] if advance else _points(writeup.rejection_reasons),
        interview_complete=assessment.interview_complete,
        ended_reason=transcript.ended_reason,
        duration_s=_duration(transcript),
        needs_human_review=bool(assessment.review_reasons),
        review_reasons=assessment.review_reasons,
        per_question=assessment.per_question,
        profile_alignment=judgement.profile_alignment.model_copy(
            update={
                "confirmed": _points(judgement.profile_alignment.confirmed),
                "contradicted": _points(judgement.profile_alignment.contradicted),
            }
        ),
        red_flags=_points(judgement.red_flags),
        communication=_sentence(judgement.communication),
    )


def report_path(session_id: str) -> pathlib.Path:
    return loader.DATA_DIR / session_id / "report.json"


def load_report(session_id: str) -> Report | None:
    loader.session_dir(session_id)  # validates the id
    path = report_path(session_id)
    if not path.is_file():
        return None
    try:
        return Report.model_validate_json(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except ValueError:
        return None  # written by an older version of the report contract


def evaluate(session_id: str) -> Report:
    """Run the full evaluation for a session and write data/<session>/report.json."""
    inputs = loader.load_session(session_id)
    transcript = load_transcript(session_id)
    model = os.environ.get("GEMINI_MODEL", "").strip()
    if not model:
        raise EvaluationError("missing environment variable: GEMINI_MODEL")
    judgement = judge(inputs, transcript, model)
    assessment = assess(inputs, transcript, judgement)
    writeup = write_decision(assessment, transcript, judgement, model)
    report = finalize(assessment, transcript, judgement, writeup, model)
    path = report_path(session_id)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(report.model_dump_json(indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    return report

You receive the decision, the overall score, and for each question the score \
and the grader's notes.

If the decision is "advance":
- summary: three or four sentences on why the candidate moves to the next \
round, leading with what they did well.
- strengths: the candidate's strongest points, most important first, each tied \
to something they demonstrated in an answer.
- next_interview_focus: what later interviews should cover: gaps and weak \
answers from this interview, and areas it did not test. Phrase each as \
something to probe.
- rejection_reasons: empty list.

If the decision is "reject":
- summary: three or four sentences stating plainly why the candidate is not \
moving forward.
- rejection_reasons: the specific reasons, most important first, each tied to \
an answer or to a question that was not answered. If the interview was \
incomplete, say so and say what was missed.
- strengths: at most two real strengths, or an empty list if there were none.
- next_interview_focus: empty list.

In both cases, reasoning is two or three sentences explaining how the three \
question scores produced the overall score, mentioning any second chance, \
hint or unanswered question that affected it.

Use only the information you are given. Do not invent facts about the \
candidate and do not quote them.

{_STYLE}"""


def _turn_line(turn: Turn) -> str:
    speaker = "Interviewer" if turn.speaker == "agent" else "Candidate"
    marks = []
    if turn.followup:
        marks.append("follow-up")
    if turn.second_chance:
        marks.append("second chance, hint given" if turn.hint else "second chance")
    marker = f" [{'; '.join(marks)}]" if marks else ""
    return f"{speaker}{marker}: {turn.text}"


def _question_block(question: Question, turns: list[Turn]) -> str:
    lines = [
        f"## {question.id}",
        f"Question: {question.question}",
        f"Reference answer: {question.answer}",
        f"Context: {question.context}",
    ]
    if question.followup is not None:
        lines += [
            f"Prepared follow-up: {question.followup.question}",
            f"Follow-up reference answer: {question.followup.answer}",
            f"Follow-up context: {question.followup.context}",
        ]
    lines.append("<transcript>")
    lines += [_turn_line(t) for t in turns] or ["(this question was never reached)"]
    lines.append("</transcript>")
    return "\n".join(lines)


def build_judge_prompt(inputs: InterviewInputs, transcript: Transcript) -> str:
    blocks = [
        _question_block(q, [t for t in transcript.turns if t.question_id == q.id])
        for q in inputs.questions
    ]
    known = {q.id for q in inputs.questions}
    other = [t for t in transcript.turns if t.question_id not in known]
    other_block = "\n".join(_turn_line(t) for t in other) or "(none)"
    ids = ", ".join(q.id for q in inputs.questions)
    return (
        f"# Candidate profile (context only)\n{inputs.candidate_profile}\n\n"
        f"# Questions and what was said\n" + "\n\n".join(blocks) + "\n\n"
        f"# Outside the questions (introduction, closing)\n"
        f"<transcript>\n{other_block}\n</transcript>\n\n"
        f"Return one per_question entry for each of: {ids}."
    )


ENDINGS = {
    "completed": "The interview ran to the end.",
    "time_limit": "The interview was cut short by the time limit.",
    "disconnected": "The candidate's connection dropped before the interview finished.",
    "stopped": "The interview was stopped before it finished.",
}


def build_writeup_prompt(
    decision: str,
    overall_score: int,
    advance_min: int,
    per_question: list[QuestionReport],
    ended_reason: str | None,
    red_flags: list[str],
) -> str:
    questions = []
    for q in per_question:
        notes = []
        if q.status == "not_answered":
            notes.append("not answered")
        if q.followup_asked:
            notes.append("follow-up asked")
        if q.second_chance_given:
            notes.append("second chance given" + (" with a hint" if q.hint_given else ""))
        if q.score_before_cap is not None:
            notes.append(
                f"score capped from {q.score_before_cap} to {q.score} because a second "
                "chance was needed"
            )
        questions.append(
            {
                "question_id": q.question_id,
                "question": q.question,
                "score": q.score,
                "notes": notes,
                "grader_reasoning": q.reasoning,
                "covered_points": q.covered_points,
                "missed_points": q.missed_points,
                "strengths": q.strengths,
                "gaps": q.gaps,
            }
        )
    payload = {
        "decision": decision,
        "overall_score": overall_score,
        "rule": f"advance at {advance_min} or above, otherwise reject",
        "how_the_interview_ended": ENDINGS.get(ended_reason or "", "Unknown."),
        "red_flags": red_flags,
        "questions": questions,
    }
    return json.dumps(payload, indent=2)

"""Evaluation agent: transcript + question docs + profile -> Report.

The model judges, the code decides:

1. judge()          Gemini grades each answer (Judgement).
2. assess()         Code checks the judgement against the transcript, applies
                    the scoring rules and fixes the decision (Assessment).
3. write_decision() Gemini explains the decision that code made (Writeup).
4. finalize()       Code assembles the Report.
"""

import dataclasses
import datetime
import os
import pathlib
import re
import statistics

from src.evaluation import prompt
from src.interview import loader
from src.interview.loader import InterviewInputs
from src.shared.models import (
    Judgement,
    QuestionJudgement,
    QuestionReport,
    Report,
    Transcript,
    Writeup,
)

# Overall score needed to move on to the next round. One constant for now.
ADVANCE_MIN = 60
# A question that needed a second chance cannot score above these.
SECOND_CHANCE_CAP = 70
HINT_CAP = 55


class EvaluationError(Exception):
    pass


@dataclasses.dataclass
class Assessment:
    per_question: list[QuestionReport]
    overall_score: int
    decision: str
    interview_complete: bool
    review_reasons: list[str]


def load_transcript(session_id: str) -> Transcript:
    loader.session_dir(session_id)  # validates the id
    for base in (loader.DATA_DIR, loader.FIXTURES_DIR):
        path = base / session_id / "transcript.json"
        if path.is_file():
            return Transcript.model_validate_json(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    raise EvaluationError(f"no transcript found for session {session_id!r}")


def _generate(model: str, system: str, contents: str, schema):
    """One Gemini call with structured output."""
    from google import genai
    from google.genai import types

    api_key = os.environ.get("GEMINI_API_KEY", "").strip()
    if not api_key:
        raise EvaluationError("missing environment variable: GEMINI_API_KEY")
    client = genai.Client(api_key=api_key)
    response = client.models.generate_content(
        model=model,
        contents=contents,
        config=types.GenerateContentConfig(
            system_instruction=system,
            response_mime_type="application/json",
            response_schema=schema,
            temperature=0.1,
        ),
    )
    if isinstance(response.parsed, schema):
        return response.parsed
    try:
        return schema.model_validate_json(response.text or "")
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise EvaluationError(f"evaluator returned invalid JSON: {exc}") from exc


def judge(inputs: InterviewInputs, transcript: Transcript, model: str) -> Judgement:
    """Ask Gemini to grade each answer."""
    contents = prompt.build_judge_prompt(inputs, transcript)
    return _generate(model, prompt.JUDGE_SYSTEM, contents, Judgement)


def write_decision(
    assessment: Assessment, transcript: Transcript, judgement: Judgement, model: str
) -> Writeup:
    """Ask Gemini to explain the decision that assess() made."""
    contents = prompt.build_writeup_prompt(
        assessment.decision,
        assessment.overall_score,
        ADVANCE_MIN,
        assessment.per_question,
        transcript.ended_reason,
        judgement.red_flags,
    )
    return _generate(model, prompt.WRITEUP_SYSTEM, contents, Writeup)


def _normalise(text: str) -> str:
    return " ".join(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", " ", text.lower()).split())


def _sentence(text: str) -> str:
    """Tidy model prose: one line, capitalised, ending with punctuation."""
    text = " ".join(str(text).split()).lstrip("-•* ").strip()
    if not text:
        return ""
    text = text[0].upper() + text[1:]
    return text if text[-1] in ".!?" else text + "."


def _points(items: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    """Tidy a list of points and drop empty or repeated ones."""
    seen, result = set(), []
    for item in items:
        point = _sentence(item)
        key = _normalise(point)
        if key and key not in seen:
            seen.add(key)
            result.append(point)
    return result


def decide(overall_score: int) -> str:
    return "advance" if overall_score >= ADVANCE_MIN else "reject"


def _empty(question_id: str, reasoning: str, gaps: list[str]) -> QuestionJudgement:
    return QuestionJudgement(
        question_id=question_id,
        score=0,
        reasoning=reasoning,
        covered_points=[],
        missed_points=[],
        strengths=[],
        gaps=gaps,
        evidence=[],
    )


def assess(inputs: InterviewInputs, transcript: Transcript, judgement: Judgement) -> Assessment:
    judged = {j.question_id: j for j in judgement.per_question}
    # Quotes are checked against everything the candidate said, not only the
    # turns tagged with that question: tagging can be off by a turn.
    spoken = _normalise(" ".join(t.text for t in transcript.turns if t.speaker == "candidate"))
    review_reasons: list[str] = []
    per_question: list[QuestionReport] = []

    for question in inputs.questions:
        turns = [t for t in transcript.turns if t.question_id == question.id]
        asked = any(t.speaker == "agent" for t in turns)
        answered = any(t.speaker == "candidate" and _normalise(t.text) for t in turns)
        facts = {
            "question": question.question,
            "followup_asked": any(t.followup for t in turns),
            "second_chance_given": any(t.second_chance for t in turns),
            "hint_given": any(t.hint for t in turns),
        }
        result = judged.get(question.id)

        if not answered:
            why = "was asked but got no answer" if asked else "was never reached"
            empty = _empty(
                question.id,
                f"This question {why}, so there is nothing to grade. It scores 0.",
                ["No answer was given."],
            )
            per_question.append(
                QuestionReport(**empty.model_dump(), status="not_answered", **facts)
            )
            review_reasons.append(f"{question.id} {why}.")
            continue

        if result is None:
            result = _empty(
                question.id, "The evaluator returned no judgement for this question.", []
            )
            review_reasons.append(f"{question.id} has no judgement from the evaluator.")

        evidence = [
            " ".join(q.split()) for q in result.evidence if _normalise(q) and _normalise(q) in spoken
        ]
        dropped = len(result.evidence) - len(evidence)
        if dropped:
            review_reasons.append(
                f"{question.id}: {dropped} quote(s) not found in the transcript were removed."
            )

        score = max(0, min(100, result.score))
        score_before_cap = None
        if facts["second_chance_given"]:
            cap = HINT_CAP if facts["hint_given"] else SECOND_CHANCE_CAP
            if score > cap:
                score_before_cap, score = score, cap
        if score > 0 and not evidence:
            review_reasons.append(f"{question.id} is scored without a verified quote.")

        per_question.append(
            QuestionReport(
                question_id=question.id,
                score=score,
                score_before_cap=score_before_cap,
                reasoning=_sentence(result.reasoning),
                covered_points=_points(result.covered_points),
                missed_points=_points(result.missed_points),
                strengths=_points(result.strengths),
                gaps=_points(result.gaps),
                evidence=evidence,
                status="answered",
                **facts,
            )
        )

    if judgement.red_flags:
        review_reasons.append(f"{len(judgement.red_flags)} red flag(s) raised.")
    if transcript.ended_reason not in (None, "completed"):
        review_reasons.append(prompt.ENDINGS[transcript.ended_reason])

    overall = round(statistics.mean(q.score for q in per_question))
    return Assessment(
        per_question=per_question,
        overall_score=overall,
        decision=decide(overall),
        interview_complete=all(q.status == "answered" for q in per_question),
        review_reasons=review_reasons,
    )


def _duration(transcript: Transcript) -> int | None:
    try:
        started = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(transcript.started_at)
        ended = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(transcript.ended_at)
    except ValueError:
        return None
    return max(0, round((ended - started).total_seconds()))


def finalize(
    assessment: Assessment,
    transcript: Transcript,
    judgement: Judgement,
    writeup: Writeup,
    model: str,
) -> Report:
    advance = assessment.decision == "advance"
    return Report(
        session_id=transcript.session_id,
        candidate_name=transcript.candidate_name,
        generated_at=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
        model=model,
        overall_score=assessment.overall_score,
        decision=assessment.decision,
        summary=" ".join(writeup.summary.split()),
        reasoning=" ".join(writeup.reasoning.split()),
        strengths=_points(writeup.strengths),
        # Each decision shows only its own section, whatever the model returned.
        next_interview_focus=_points(writeup.next_interview_focus) if advance else [],
        rejection_reasons=[] if advance else _points(writeup.rejection_reasons),
        interview_complete=assessment.interview_complete,
        ended_reason=transcript.ended_reason,
        duration_s=_duration(transcript),
        needs_human_review=bool(assessment.review_reasons),
        review_reasons=assessment.review_reasons,
        per_question=assessment.per_question,
        profile_alignment=judgement.profile_alignment.model_copy(
            update={
                "confirmed": _points(judgement.profile_alignment.confirmed),
                "contradicted": _points(judgement.profile_alignment.contradicted),
            }
        ),
        red_flags=_points(judgement.red_flags),
        communication=_sentence(judgement.communication),
    )


def report_path(session_id: str) -> pathlib.Path:
    return loader.DATA_DIR / session_id / "report.json"


def load_report(session_id: str) -> Report | None:
    loader.session_dir(session_id)  # validates the id
    path = report_path(session_id)
    if not path.is_file():
        return None
    try:
        return Report.model_validate_json(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except ValueError:
        return None  # written by an older version of the report contract


def evaluate(session_id: str) -> Report:
    """Run the full evaluation for a session and write data/<session>/report.json."""
    inputs = loader.load_session(session_id)
    transcript = load_transcript(session_id)
    model = os.environ.get("GEMINI_MODEL", "").strip()
    if not model:
        raise EvaluationError("missing environment variable: GEMINI_MODEL")
    judgement = judge(inputs, transcript, model)
    assessment = assess(inputs, transcript, judgement)
    writeup = write_decision(assessment, transcript, judgement, model)
    report = finalize(assessment, transcript, judgement, writeup, model)
    path = report_path(session_id)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(report.model_dump_json(indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    return report

All six feedback items are in and working end to end. A final simulated voice interview with deliberately weak answers ran in 2.5 minutes, used both second chances, and was automatically evaluated to a reject at 51/100.

## What changed
1. **Time limit:** the interviewer says up front that the interview takes fifteen minutes at most. At 12 minutes it is told to close after the current answer; at 15 the session ends regardless.
2. **Second chance:** after a clearly wrong or stuck answer, the interviewer invites one more try. It gives a small hint only when the candidate is stuck, and the code refuses a third try.
3. **Report is internal:** the candidate page now ends with "Thank you, the team will be in touch" and has no link to results. Evaluation runs automatically when the interview ends, and the server terminal prints the recruiter link.
4. **Binary decision:** advance at 60 or above, otherwise reject. An advance report shows strengths and what later interviews should cover; a reject report shows the specific reasons. A second-chance answer is capped at 70, or 55 with a hint.
5. **Report polish:** new page with a decision banner, score against the bar, per-question cards with badges and quotes, the full transcript, and a print-to-PDF button.
6. **Fillers:** if Gemini has said nothing 2 seconds after the candidate finishes, the interviewer says "Mhm.", "I see." or similar, then the real reply.

## Dry-run transcript
From `data/dryrun/transcript.json`:

| Time | Speaker | Tag | Text |
| - | - | - | - |
| 3.0 | Agent | – | Hi Sam, I'm Harper! How are you doing today? |
| 7.7 | Candidate | – | Hi Harper, I'm good, thanks. |
| 12.3 | Agent | q1 | Glad to hear that. I have three questions about the codebase you'd be working on, and the interview will take fifteen minutes at most. In our interview product, a language model scores each answer, but the final hiring score and the recommendation are calculated in plain code, not by the model. Why would you design it that way? |
| 33.0 | Candidate | q1 | It's because code runs faster than the model, so it's a performance thing. |
| 39.9 | Agent | q1, second chance | That's not quite what we're looking for. Feel free to take another run at it. |
| 47.5 | Candidate | q1, second chance | Maybe it is cheaper? |
| 51.3 | Agent | q2 | Got it. During the voice interview, the language model has to call a tool before it asks each question, and the server keeps track of where the interview is. What does that give us compared with simply writing the rules in the prompt? |
| 64.8 | Candidate | q2 | If the server keeps the state and the model has to ask through a tool, the server can refuse a question out of order or a second follow-up. A prompt alone is just a suggestion. |
| 76.8 | Agent | q2 follow-up | Thanks. What happens if the model skips the tool call and just asks the next question out loud? |
| 83.8 | Candidate | q2 follow-up | I don't know. |
| 87.0 | Agent | q2 follow-up, second chance + hint | Think about what happens to the transcript and the interview state if that occurs. Would you like another try? |
| 95.4 | Candidate | q2 follow-up, second chance + hint | the server still thinks we're on the old question. So the answer gets recorded under the wrong question and graded against the wrong reference answer. |
| 106.3 | Agent | q3 | Got it. The interview transcript has to be saved when the interview ends normally, when the candidate closes the browser, and when a time limit is reached. How would you make sure it is saved in all three cases, and what could still go wrong? |
| 121.3 | Candidate | q3 | I would put the save in a finally block so it runs however the session ends, and route the disconnect and the timer through the same exit, a crash could still lose it because it's only in memory. |

The report scored the questions 20, 55 (capped from 68 because of the hint) and 78. I've since fixed the doubled "Thanks. Thank you" in the goodbye.

## How to look at it
```

```
- Candidate page: `http://localhost:8000/?session=example`
- Recruiter report: `http://localhost:8000/internal/report?session=dryrun` (reject with second chances) or `?session=demo` (advance, 63/100)

- **Your live run:** `data/example` held a live interview you did earlier (the "revealed to me in a dream" one). I re-evaluated it with the new evaluator, so its report is replaced: 27/100, reject, with the joke answer listed as a red flag. The transcript is untouched.
- **Your live transcript has gaps:** the agent's opening hello is missing and the first question is cut before "Why would you design it that way?". That usually means the agent was interrupted, by you speaking early or by the microphone picking up the speakers. A headset should prevent it.

- **Not tested at all:** the 15-minute hard stop.
- **Report access:** the report page has no access control, as agreed; anyone with the URL can open it until the platform adds that.
